question: Which products does NVIDIA's Data Center market platform offer, according to its fiscal 2026 10-K?

content.text:
{"reasoning":"Start at NVDA's Company node and its FY2026 10-K Filing. Follow HAS_MARKET_PLATFORM to a MarketPlatform whose name or aliases contain 'data center', then OFFERS to Product. Keep chunk IDs from the OFFERS edge that belong to the filing, and add the chunks the Product points to via EVIDENCED_BY that are PART_OF the filing. Rows with more evidence come first.","cypher":"MATCH (co:Company {ticker: 'NVDA'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing {form_type: '10-K', fiscal_period: 'FY2026'})
MATCH (co)-[:HAS_MARKET_PLATFORM]->(mp:MarketPlatform)-[o:OFFERS]->(p:Product)
WHERE any(x IN [mp.name] + coalesce(mp.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(x) CONTAINS 'data center' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'datacenter')
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(f)
WITH mp, p, [cid IN o.chunk_ids WHERE cid STARTS WITH f.accession_no + ':'] AS edge_ids, collect(c.chunk_id) AS node_ids
WITH mp, p, edge_ids + node_ids AS ids
WHERE size(ids) > 0
RETURN mp.name AS market_platform, p.name AS product, ids AS chunk_ids
ORDER BY size(ids) DESC"}
